title: Scroll-Based Effects
prompt: Prototype a scroll-driven enhancement for a nonessential decoration. Include a reduced-motion override and document the browser-support assumption.
objective: Demonstrate scroll-driven animation, progressive enhancement in a small stylesheet and explain the behavior.
expected_output: A stylesheet that meets the acceptance criteria for Scroll-Based Effects and passes manual browser checks.
acceptance_criteria: Test the interface at a narrow and wide viewport where relevant.
Record one explanation of why the CSS produces the observed result.
hints: Identify the smallest selector that needs to change.
Add one property or state at a time, then inspect the result.
Use browser developer tools and an official reference to resolve unexpected behavior.
grading_method: Server-side required-string smoke check plus human review. This does not prove that a rendered page is visually or accessibly correct.
retry_policy: Allow retries. Only a correct server-side check may complete the activity; XP is controlled by CodeLeaf backend rules and is not configured in this file.
status_note: Draft until the starter, expected behavior, browser compatibility, and manual review rubric are verified.
